verdict.rationale: The evidence pack describes general triage/noise features (AI post-processing to reduce noise, ticketing/alerts, reachability analysis) but never mentions severity levels, confidence scores, or a mechanism to filter/gate CI builds based on them. Missing for 10: explicit severity/confidence filtering flags (e.g., --severity), CI gating configuration based on severity/confidence thresholds, and documentation tying these to build pass/fail behavior.
